findings.quote: Our internal policy caps post-termination confidentiality obligations at 18 months from the date of disclosure. Please confirm if Clause 10.3 can be amended accordingly.
our standard position is for Dutch law and the District Court of Amsterdam (Rechtbank Amsterdam) to apply under Clauses 12.10 and 12.11
